title: Network printer stops responding after router restart
summary: Printer drops off the network when it gets a new IP from DHCP.
details: The printer was set to DHCP, so a router restart gave it a different IP. Fix: set a static IP on the printer, or reserve its MAC in the router DHCP table, then update the port in Printers & Scanners.
author: J. Perera

title: SAP GUI error: Partner not reached (connection refused)
summary: SAP logon fails with a connection-refused message after a VPN change.
details: The message server host in SAP Logon still pointed at the old hostname. Fix: update the Application Server / Message Server entry, confirm the system number, and make sure the VPN route to the SAP subnet is up.
author: N. Fernando

title: Printer driver install fails with error 0x00000057
summary: Windows rejects the driver during Add Printer.
details: A corrupted driver store entry blocked the install. Fix: run 'printui /s /t2' to remove the old driver package, delete it from the driver store, reboot, then install the latest signed driver from the vendor.
author: S. Jayawardena

title: VPN connects but no internal access
summary: Tunnel is up but internal hosts are unreachable.
details: Split-tunnel was pushing only part of the internal range. Fix: add the missing subnet to the VPN routes, flush DNS, and confirm the internal DNS server is set on the VPN adapter.
author: A. Silva
